_doc: Developer overlay for the core ShaderInjection target registry. Core owns source paths, compile profiles, defines, and runtime SHA1 identities.

replacements.name: deferred_composite
replacements.comment: HELD/unmapped. Live 1.11.221 composite runtime sha is 7cdee7be (BSDFCompositeShader tech=616, .fxp blob 3531: 139 insns, t0-t9 incl. a texturecubearray@t8, CB2[6] - the rich cubemap-array IBL variant). Our DeferredComposite.hlsl reconstructs blob 3539 (90 insns, t0/t3/t4/t5/t7/t11, CB2[3] - simpler variant) whose SRV/sampler contract is INCOMPATIBLE with 3531 (declares t11/s11 the runtime lacks; missing t6/t8-cubearray/t9) -> would hazard, not just mis-shade. Needs a reconstruction of blob 3531 before mapping. Prior 813c9ace was a pre-next-gen sha (never matches on 1.11.221).

replacements.comment: Live AE POINT permutation from FO4_frame24669: sha 9969e800683c8a7c8afc25f41582415d79cbe47e, Shaders011 blobs 3287/3316, CB12[30], CB2[15]. Historical frame9483 sha 3f1f708c is a different CB2[23] permutation and is not mapped.

replacements.name: bsdf_light_deferred_directional
replacements.comment: BSDFLightShader sun DIRECTIONAL permutation (2-cascade), role deferred_directional_light. Live 1.11.221 runtime sha = .fxp blob 3295, body-confirmed cascade-by-depth sun (radial-attenuation-free, cb2[10] cascade ranges). Prior 8c615844 was stale; 46b911cb before that was a misattributed 61-insn fog pass.

replacements.name: bsdf_light_deferred_directional_ibl
replacements.comment: BSDFLightShader sun DIRECTIONAL + ambient-IBL-in-light permutation, role deferred_directional_light (sibling of 50e2618e). Same role receives the SCREEN_SPACE_SHADOWS define when ScreenSpaceShadows is loaded + its mask is allocated.
